purpose: Clear every v1 migration uncertainty without promoting parent evidence across refined child boundaries.

method.review_rule: A parent evidence set transfers only when its recorded supported statements and boundaries treat the child. Otherwise migration is reviewed-no-transfer and coverage remains NOT_MAPPED.
method.empty_gap_rule: An evidence-free v0 priority gap becomes a child priority gap only after the child missing object is stated explicitly.

evidence_batches.reviewed_scope: Internal spectra, state measures, and one-parameter dynamics are reviewed; the records explicitly exclude causal propagation and interacting/renormalized field theory.
Finite phase-space, categorical protocol, and state-reconstruction results do not establish evolution well-posedness, causal propagation, or quantum field consistency obligations.
Constructive duality and internal one-parameter dynamics do not transfer to causal Green theory or interacting/renormalized field theory.
Finite contextual and categorical structures do not establish causal propagation or the six quantum-consistency children.
The explicit Krein carrier, pseudo-Hermitian structure, and axiomatic indefinite-metric QFT do not construct the unresolved interaction or quantum-consistency children.
Real-spectrum and indefinite-metric QFT results do not establish the unresolved interaction or quantum-consistency children.
ZF operator theory and effective spectral representation do not establish interacting QFT, renormalized products, anomalies, QME restoration, or residual transfer.
Effective spectral representation and categorical protocols do not establish the unresolved field-interaction and quantum-consistency children.
Constructive probability, Hilbert logic, effective spectra, and a representation-sensitive wave counterexample do not establish interacting or renormalized QFT children.
Synthetic classical geometry and local BRST classification do not construct or represent states, probabilities, or a physical state-selection rule.
Lattice constraints and continuum-comparison programmes do not by themselves construct the four unresolved state/probability children.
PT-symmetric and pseudo-Hermitian spectral structure does not supply state representation, normalized probabilities, or causal Green propagation.
Logical-strength results for separation and Hahn-Banach principles do not construct a generator, well-posed evolution, or a causal Green operator.
The reviewed synthetic Einstein-equation formulation does not construct spectral generators, prove evolution well-posedness, or provide causal Green maps.
The exact energy spectrum is a reduced-mode spectral result and explicitly does not establish causal support or a Green operator.
AQFT state-space and BV-renormalization architecture does not derive a normalized probability rule for the Weyl metric theory.
Localic duality and effective spectral representation do not construct localized causal Green propagation.
State measures and internal one-parameter groups do not establish spacetime support or causal Green propagation.
